children: OceanLight Acquisition announced holders may separately trade ordinary shares, rights and warrants beginning on or about Sept 11, 2026.
Holders of units may elect to separate units into ordinary shares, rights and warrants starting on or about Sept 11, 2026.
Unseparated units will continue trading on Nasdaq Global Market under the symbol OCLTU.
Separated securities expected to trade on Nasdaq Capital Market as OCLT (shares), OCLTR (rights) and OCLTW (warrants).
Brokers must contact Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, the transfer agent, to effect unit separations.
Each unit contains one ordinary share, one right to 1/4 share on a business combination, and one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50.
